messages:
Alex: Heads up — prepping release notes + internal announce for v1.18.0. Change window Fri 03/27 20:00-20:30 UTC (Fri 1pm PT). Draft below. Need owners: comms, ops pin, and canary run. Can we dry-run in staging at 19:00 UTC?

Priya: Copy looks solid. Add a short line about embeddings fallback to v1.17.x in case of regressions. Also ping legal if we mention billing. :eyes:

Marta: Ops here — I can own the pin and canary. Proposed rollout: canary 5% for 15m, then 50% for 10m, then full. Rollback trigger: error rate > 2% or latency p95 > 500ms. Will post runbook steps. @Alex please confirm metric thresholds.

deploy-bot: deploybot: staging deploy initiated by @marta for v1.18.0 (staging). Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/build/6823 :gear:

Sam: Quick note — there is an opt-in token billing change tied to model selection. I think keep that out of internal announce, but product should have a short customer blurb.

Alex: Agreed — internal announce should focus on ops impact + rollback. Customer-facing RN will be separate. Draft release notes (internal) below: 

```
Release v1.18.0 — internal summary
- Improved inference runtime: reduced cold-starts for dedicated pools
- Streaming API: header change to support chunked metadata (backwards compatible)
- Embeddings: new retrain pipeline + optional quantized variant (v1.17 fallback available)
- Ops: rollout plan + canary gating; rollback to v1.17.x if regressions
- Note: no customer billing changes in this deploy

Risk & mitigations:
- Latency spikes: prefix cache warm-up during canary
- Model mismatch for private deployments: pinned to exact model hash by default

Rollout steps:
1) Stage deploy (19:00 UTC)
2) Canary 5% (20:00 UTC) — 15m monitor
3) Canary 50% — 10m monitor
4) Full rollout (conditional)

Rollback commands:
- rollback to v1.17: `infra rolling-update --service=runtime --image=runtime:v1.17.9`
- emergency revert: `infra emergency-revert runtime --to=stable`
```

Julian: Who will publish the internal announce in #all-hands? Also we should include a 1-sentence customer blurb for comms to adapt.

Priya: I'll draft the all-hands post and customer one-liner. Internal announce (short):

"Deploying v1.18.0 Friday 20:00 UTC. Expect a brief canary window; ops will monitor latency and errors. No customer billing changes." :white_check_mark:

Marta: Ops checklist (short):
- pin infra images to hashes
- verify KVM/keys on private deploys
- enable detailed tracing for first 30m
- deploy command (prod): `deploy --env=prod --version=1.18.0 --canary=5%`
- rollback if error_rate>2% or p95>500ms

ops-oncall: I will be oncall for the window. I'll join voice and watch the canary dash. If anyone can't make it, say now.

Alex: Thanks all. Final steps: Priya will post internal announce in #all-hands and #eng-releases, Marta will kick the staging dry-run at 19:00 UTC, ops-oncall will monitor, Sam and product will prep customer blurb for Monday external RN. We'll reconvene here after staging smoke. :rocket: 

deploy-bot: staging deploy completed (success). Tests: 102 passed, 3 flaky. link: https://ci.internal/redwood/build/6823/results

Alex: Staging smoke looks good, proceeding to scheduled production canary at 20:00 UTC as planned.
